mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id=#{userId} AND u.enabled AND NOT u.archived AND (',' || u.roles || ',' LIKE '%,SUPER_ADMIN,%' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM construction_access a WHERE a.user_id=u.id)))

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.full_name, u.enabled, (a.user_id IS NOT NULL) AS granted, a.construction_role, (',' || u.roles || ',' LIKE '%,SUPER_ADMIN,%') AS super_admin FROM users u LEFT JOIN construction_access a ON a.user_id=u.id WHERE NOT u.archived ORDER BY u.username
SELECT construction_role FROM construction_access WHERE user_id=#{userId}
SELECT id FROM users WHERE id=#{userId} AND NOT archived FOR UPDATE
SELECT project_id FROM construction_foreman_sites WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY project_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO construction_access(user_id,granted_by,construction_role) VALUES(#{userId},#{actor},#{role}) ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET granted_by=EXCLUDED.granted_by,granted_at=now(),construction_role=EXCLUDED.construction_role
INSERT INTO construction_access(user_id, granted_by) VALUES(#{userId},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET granted_by=EXCLUDED.granted_by, granted_at=now()

mapper.select: SELECT FROM construction_workers ORDER BY active DESC, full_name, id

mapper.update: UPDATE construction_attendance SET project_id=#{projectId},work_date=#{workDate},kind=#{kind},workdays=#{workdays},hours=#{hours},overtime_hours=#{overtimeHours},base_wages=#{baseWages},overtime=#{overtime},recorded_by=#{recordedBy} WHERE id=#{id} AND payroll_id IS NULL

mapper.select: SELECT FROM construction_payrolls WHERE from_date <= #{to} AND to_date >= #{from} AND worker_id=#{workerId}AND project_id=#{projectId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id
SELECT FROM construction_payrolls WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT count(*) FROM construction_payrolls WHERE worker_id=#{workerId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND status!='CANCELLED' AND from_date <= #{to} AND to_date >= #{from}
mapper.update: UPDATE construction_attendance SET payroll_id=#{payroll.id} WHERE worker_id=#{payroll.workerId} AND project_id=#{payroll.projectId} AND work_date BETWEEN #{payroll.fromDate} AND #{payroll.toDate} AND payroll_id IS NULL
